task.title: Define optimizer outputs and registry handoff rules
task.next: EV-002 finalized: optimizer output contract, registry handoff rules, and promotion gate dependencies fully defined. All acceptance criteria met and review approved by Codex.
task.summary_zh: 定義 optimizer 產出與 registry handoff 規則，確保優化結果先變成受治理 artifact 再決定是否升版。
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：前一輪兩個 blocker 已收斂。§3.1 與 §4.5/§5.3 現在一致限制 optimizer baseline 只能來自 candidate 或 paper，不再對 live baseline 自相矛盾。
candidate → paper gate 現在只接受 candidate_to_paper，已對齊 EV-001 recommendation semantics 與 INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md 的 promotion check；兩個 optimizer_result 範例也都重新驗證通過。

handoffs.message: EV-002 contract complete. Please review: (1) services/evaluation/optimizers/contract.md — optimizer_result artifact type, registry handoff rules, promotion gate dependencies; (2) optimizer_result.schema.json + 2 validated examples; (3) registry_entry_schema.json and registry/contract.md updated to include optimizer_result artifact type. All 3 acceptance criteria satisfied: versionable artifacts defined, handoff rules documented, promotion gate dependencies identified.

Review blocked: optimizer contract still contradicts itself on whether live artifacts may be optimizer baselines, and candidate→paper incorrectly accepts paper_to_live as a valid evaluation recommendation. See services/evaluation/optimizers/review_ev002_codex.md.

EV-002 contract revised — two blocking governance contradictions fixed. (1) §3.1 diagram 'paper or live' → 'candidate or paper', now consistent with §4.5 and §5.3 live-baseline prohibition. (2) §6.2 recommendation set {candidate_to_paper, paper_to_live} → candidate_to_paper only, now consistent with EV-001 recommendation semantics and INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:549. Both JSON examples still validate against schema. Please re-review services/evaluation/optimizers/contract.md.

EV-002 re-review approved. The live-baseline contradiction and candidate->paper recommendation drift are resolved, and both optimizer_result examples still validate against schema. Owner can finalize to done.
